title: Topology variants + planner/executor
acceptance_criterion: Selection follows measured utility; a simpler workflow may win
stdout:
Phase 4 shipped. Single-agent (ReAct-style) and bounded planner/executor variants on the same
tool contracts, selectable through a registry. ADR-0006 records the shipping choice: the fixed
graph is the default because the held-out comparison showed the simpler topology wins — single_agent
spent 2-10x the completion tokens of fixed for no measurable quality gain.

Only fixed and single_agent were carried into the held-out run (see held-out-v1/manifest.json
selected_topologies); planner_executor ships but was not part of the frozen experiment.
evidence: docs/adr/0006-topology.md — fixed graph shipped as the default
experiments/held-out-v1/uncertainty.md: fixed 0/12, single_agent 0/12; single_agent burned 2-10x completion tokens for no measured gain

synthesized.note: The /dev-kit:build runner was never executed in this monorepo. The AgentOps Workbench was built in a standalone repo and imported via PR #8, so no per-step sub-agent subprocess output was ever captured. This file is reconstructed from the shipped artifacts under apps/agentops-workbench/ plus a re-run of the deterministic gates on 2026-09-11. exit_code / acceptance_met are judgements against the shipped tree, not a recorded process exit.
